record.name: Fates In Flux
record.community_notes: [APPROX] Modeled with the pooled-resource `replace-roll-from-pool` frame over a `flux-token-pool`, covering the rolls a Flux token affects for your LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH units. Semantically a Flux token funds a re-roll (not a die-value substitution), and the token economy — starting with three tokens, the opponent gaining a token whenever you spend one, the reciprocal opponent re-roll, and the Command-phase regain — is not modeled. Pool state is not tracked by the buff layer (fail-safe). Full rule in raw-text store.

Full rule in raw-text store.
